summary: OpenTable is a restaurant reservation and management platform owned by Booking Holdings (alongside Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, and KAYAK), helping more than 60,000 restaurants worldwide fill approximately 1.8 billion seats per year; it earns revenue via flat monthly and per-reservation fees charged to restaurants, while remaining free for diners.

OpenTable faces growing competition from Resy and Tock, which merged (both under American Express ownership) to form a reservations marketplace of approximately 25,000 restaurants. (Scope note: Competitive dynamic (Resy/Tock merger under Amex) is reported but exact deal terms/date were not independently verified in this pass.)

OpenTable has required (or moved to require) participating restaurants to make it their primary reservations system, a policy shift reported by Restaurant Business that affects operators using multiple reservation platforms simultaneously.
